title: Fusion Charity Drive 2027
resources: Venue booking, sound system and a volunteer team of 20 students

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 99 attendees for this Charity Drive, in line with turnout at our previous Charity Drive events.
The requested budget of INR 12,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Charity Drive.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
